planning_cautions: Four exploratory seeds provide fragile means and SD estimates. Half/double SD sensitivity is illustrative, not a variance confidence interval.
Observed plug-in power uses noisy exploratory effects and is not assurance or a guaranteed future success probability.
Specified .01-nat / .01-accuracy-advantage distances are transparent design scenarios, not observed facts or qualification thresholds.
Per-endpoint 80% power does not imply 80% power to reject all 19 cells.
No joint scoped privacy pass is possible with the current 20/24 unqualified instruments.
recommendation: NO-GO for a claim that this eight-seed design is adequately powered to confirm rejection of the full finite family. Keep the exploratory paper route or review revised precision/claim/sample-size objectives before any new execution.

recorded_seed_audit.scope: Recorded legacy manifests, R1 execution summaries including interrupted/failed stages, inventories and calibration analysis only; repeat against live attempt logs before freeze.

scope: Prospective planning from exploratory results; exact marginal noncentral-t power conditional on assumed means/SD and normal independent training-seed observations, not empirical confirmation.
